name: Royler
trait: Fastest horse in Pywel
summary: The white legendary horse with golden legs. It reaches the top Speed and Acceleration ratings, holds the deepest stamina pool of any mount on record, and is the one horse that learns Consecutive Instant Acceleration: a second boost out of every drift.

speed.basis: Speed 5 and Acceleration 5 at Lv 5, plus Consecutive Instant Acceleration — no other horse gets the second boost.

stamina.basis: 390 Stamina at Lv 5, the highest figure recorded for any mount.

travel.basis: Top speed on the longest stamina bar, with Water Sprint and Double Jump to cut corners.

combat.basis: 23 Attack at Lv 5. A horse only fights through its champron charge and back kick.

steps: Ride north from the City of Hernand into Pailune's Silverwolf Mountains.
Find the lake beside Snowgrass Hearth campsite, just under the “P” of “Pailune” on the world map. The route passes a Black Bear camp you can ride straight past.
Mount Royler and win the taming minigame: steer against the way it bucks until the bar fills. The cold here drains stamina faster.
Register it with any stable manager (Hernand Stable, north-west of Hernand Castle, is the closest).

location: Lakeshore beside Snowgrass Hearth campsite, Silverwolf Mountains, Pailune.
notes: Fail the minigame and it bolts. Leave the area and come back to respawn it.
Royler is reachable early: the lake sits just north of the starting city.

name: Rokade
trait: Toughest horse — highest Health
summary: The charcoal-black legendary horse of the Steel Mountains. It carries the most Health of any horse and tops the herd in Handling and Jump at max level, which makes it the safest horse to ride through a fight.

speed.basis: Speed 4 and Acceleration 4 at Lv 5 — one step under Royler and Camora.

travel.basis: Handling 5 and Jump 5 at Lv 5 (best of all horses) with Water Sprint.

combat.basis: 840 Health at Lv 5 — the hardest horse to knock out — but only 26 Attack.

steps: Head south-east of the City of Hernand into the Steel Mountains (Grace Estate).
Find the lake near the Spire of Insight; Rokade grazes on the grass around it.
Mount it and win the taming minigame. The climate here is mild, so stamina drains at the normal rate.
Register it with any stable manager.

location: Grassland around the lake near the Spire of Insight, Grace Estate, Steel Mountains.
notes: Farther from Hernand than Royler's lake, but easier to tame thanks to the mild weather.

name: Camora
trait: Hardest-hitting horse — top Attack & Defense
summary: The blood-red legendary horse of the Redtree Forest. It has the highest Attack and Defense of any horse and reaches the same Speed rating as Royler at max level, without Royler's extra boost.

speed.basis: Speed 5 and Acceleration 5 at Lv 5, but no Consecutive Instant Acceleration.

travel.basis: Fast with Water Sprint and Double Jump; the long ride south is the only drawback.

combat.basis: 33 Attack and 120 Defense at Lv 5 — best of all horses, still below the beast mounts.

steps: Travel to the far south-east of Pywel: the Redtree Forest by the Red River, southern Crimson Desert (Tashkalp).
Camora roams the grass around the giant red tree with a herd of ordinary horses.
Mount it and win the taming minigame; the climate does not drain extra stamina.
Register it with any stable manager.

location: Grassland around the giant red tree, Redtree Forest, by the Red River.
notes: Look for the red bay coat among the herd — the other horses here are ordinary breeds.

name: Blackstar
trait: Fire-breathing flight over all of Pywel
summary: Kliff's dragon, earned at the close of Chapter 11. It flies anywhere on the continent and rains Fireball and Fire Breath on camps from above — rationed by a real-time timer.

speed.basis: True flight with dive-bomb acceleration; nothing in the sky outpaces it.

stamina.basis: About 15 real-time minutes per summon, then roughly 50 minutes of cooldown.

travel.basis: Crosses any terrain on the map in a straight line.

combat.basis: 2,500 Health, Fireball and Fire Breath from the air — built for clearing whole camps.

steps: Meet and cleanse the wounded Blackstar at the Palace of Urdavah during Chapter 9 (The Sage of the Desert).
Push on to the Chapter 11 finale and bring down the Golden Star; White Crow then hands you control of the dragon.
Summon it from the mount wheel in open outdoor space. It cannot be called inside the Abyss.

location: Story unlock — no world location.
notes: Active for about 15 real-time minutes per summon, followed by roughly 50 minutes of real-time cooldown. Resting does not shorten it.
The Enhanced update (2.0) added camera-based and manual flight control options.

trait: Keeps fighting after you dismount
summary: The pale legendary wolf at the end of House Celeste's Legendary Wolf questline. Slow and short-winded under a rider, it keeps fighting on its own after you step down.

travel.basis: Slow with a tiny stamina bar; a fighting mount, not a traveller.

combat.basis: 100 Attack and an aggressive AI that fights alongside you on foot.

name: Ocean Drifter
trait: Fastest underwater mount
summary: An ancient diving machine sealed in the Forgotten Ocean Ruins. It outruns every sea creature — and your ship — below the surface, but it only works submerged and punishes surfacing with an hour-long lockout.

speed.basis: The fastest underwater mount, faster than your ship (Game8, GameRant).

stamina.basis: “Exceptional stamina” (GameRant); Ascend trades stamina for a burst.

travel.basis: Unmatched for crossing deep water — mind the 60-minute cooldown.

combat.basis: No attack documented.

steps: Sail to Razanui Island in the south-west sea and mark the water north-west of it.
Dive about 55 m to the Forgotten Ocean Ruins and enter through the north-facing door.
Swim up through the ceiling gaps to the top floor and open the chest for the Ancients' Chest.
Use the Ancients' Chest from your inventory (Key Items). The Ocean Drifter registers instantly.

location: Forgotten Ocean Ruins, ~55 m down, north-west of Razanui Island.
notes: Works only underwater, from roughly 30 m down.
Surfacing or summoning another mount despawns it and starts a 60-minute real-time cooldown — fast travel away from it and you wait an hour.

summary: Top Movement Speed and Acceleration with 14,000 Health — the best statline of any vessel (KeenGamer). Two blueprint halves, one in Delesyia and one in the desert.

name: Leaping Kuku Bird
trait: No fall damage — glides down from any height
summary: A flightless crimson bird that leaps higher than a man and glides down safely from any drop. Since patch 1.10 the egg hatches into a Kuku Bird Chick pet that you raise into the mount.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average.

travel.basis: Trait override: high leaps and no fall damage turn cliffs into shortcuts.

combat.basis: No combat moves; a pure traversal mount.

routes.label: Get the egg
steps: Bloodsteel Camp, southern Demeniss: clear or slip past the Blinding Arrow garrison and find the tall wooden tower beside the makeshift throne.
Climb to the panel wall just under the roof, cling with Resist (Q / LT / L2) and hit it with Force Palm to rotate it open.
Mask on, take the Kuku Bird's Egg — and the Leaping Kuku Bird Research Journal on the table — then wait inside until the theft cools off.

routes.label: Hatch and raise it
steps: Carry the egg to the nest beside a tree in the forest between Kingshield Dig Site and Grey Rock Quarry, north of the “D” in “Demeniss”. Use the egg from your inventory to place it; it pulses orange when seated.
Wait about five minutes until it glows bright orange, then interact to hatch a Kuku Bird Chick (it registers as a pet).
Keep the chick out and drop fruit and vegetables for it. Rest a day and feed again until it reaches growth level 3.
Interact with the chick and choose Grow — it becomes the Leaping Kuku Bird mount.

location: Egg: tower room, Bloodsteel Camp (southern Demeniss). Nest: forest between Kingshield Dig Site and Grey Rock Quarry.
notes: Before patch 1.10 the egg hatched straight into an adult mount; guides written before June 2026 skip the chick stage.
Want both the pet and the mount? Hatch two eggs.
Kuku Bird Saddle (+20 Defense): Driana at Calphade Saddlery or Fiona at Demeniss Saddlery, 28 Silver.

travel.basis: All-terrain, and underwater once refitted.

combat.basis: “The tank of all mounts” — strong attacks and defence (Destructoid).

routes.label: Unlock
steps: Chapter 10 lends you an A.T.A.G. during the mecha siege.
In Chapter 11, accept the faction quest New Designs and speak with the artisan Marek at Zargan Tankworks, west Gorthak.
He gives the Small Kuku A.T.A.G. Design — the full blueprint. Craft it to keep the A.T.A.G. permanently.

routes.label: Underwater (DLC)
steps: Find the three Ancient Marine Exploration blueprints (Plate, Pack, Footwear) inside underwater temples.

Dispatch two members, one a Skilled Engineer, for each part at Delesyia's research bases (Plating: Marni's Masterium; Pack: Aeronautical Research Base). Each part costs a Natural Pearl plus hides or Manganese, 16k Camp Weapons, 9k Provisions and 100k Funds.
Equip the three parts to take the A.T.A.G. underwater.

location: Blueprint: Marek, Zargan Tankworks (west Gorthak).
notes: Game8 calls the refitted A.T.A.G. the ideal choice for underwater combat.
The High-Mobility A.T.A.G. is a separate, lighter mech built from the same Small Kuku A.T.A.G.; it has its own plate.

name: High-Mobility A.T.A.G.
trait: A lighter mech, stripped of armour for mobility
summary: An A.T.A.G. stripped of its excess armour: lighter and quicker on its feet, at the cost of half the Health and some punch. You build it from a Small Kuku A.T.A.G. at Grimnir's shop.

speed.basis: Stripped of armour to enhance mobility (Vulkk) — quicker than the A.T.A.G.

travel.basis: All-terrain walker with a cooldown.

combat.basis: 500 Health and 25 Attack — a fifth of the A.T.A.G.'s 2,500 Health (The Games Wiki).

routes.label: Blueprint
steps: Cleanse the Sanctum of Exaltation, between Silver Wolf Mountain and the City of Pailune (The Witch of Kindness questline). It gives Kuku Robot Special Blueprint II: High-Mobility A.T.A.G.

routes.label: Build
steps: Go to Grimnir's Kuku Shop in Hernand and open Kuku Item Crafting and Enhancement.
Craft it from 1 Small Kuku A.T.A.G., 400 Small Batteries, 200 Cogwheels, 2 Power Cores – Crown of Shadows and 1 Core of Temperance.

location: Blueprint: Sanctum of Exaltation, Pailune. Crafted at Grimnir's Kuku Shop, Hernand.
notes: Heal it with Healing Force Palm.
An A.T.A.G. Emergency Power Device cuts its cooldown by 10 minutes.
The Heavy Assault A.T.A.G. is not on the roster: it is only borrowed from Gorthak hangars, and no blueprint builds one.
The Games Wiki describes a research-project unlock instead; this plate follows Vulkk's blueprint-and-craft route.

name: Pywel Wagon

summary: A horse-drawn trading wagon built through the Greymane camp — slow, but it carries goods.

steps: Unlock Dispatch Missions with the Chapter 3 quest Bustling Hill.
Recruit Brice the Wagonmaster through A Rumor at Glenbright Farm (Embers of Return).
After the first four Greymane Commissions, take Brice's Request and talk to the Stranger by the wagon wheels at Timberturner Wainwright, east of Howling Hill.

notes: The same mission list builds two bigger wagons, each with its own plate: the Freight Wagon and the Trading Wagon.
